name: codex_vlm_refinement

modes.interactive: User runs the command, the runner prints CODEX_VLM_REQUEST, Codex returns JSON, user pastes it in the terminal.
modes.file: Runner waits for codex_response.json in each iteration folder.
modes.schedule: Fully automatic local Codex prompt schedule, useful for unattended runs.

clean_view: Each finished run creates RUN_README.md and review/<target>/ with readable images, prompts, decisions, and compact metrics.
